material_findings.title: Provably Subexponential Algorithms for Bounded-Error LWE with Few Samples
material_findings.evidence: Lin and Vasudevan claim a Wagner/BKW-style LWE algorithm with 2^{O(n/log log n)} running time under specified modulus, error and sample restrictions.
material_findings.limitations: Abstract and source index verified; proof and experiments not reproduced. No inference about concrete ML-KEM/ML-DSA breaks.
material_findings.next_action: Inspect full proof/assumptions and evaluate toy deterministic examples before promoting a research case.
